one_liner: The strict 'Empress' vice president: proud, perfectionist, mother-worshipping, and secretly a gentle flower-gardener.
personality: Severe and commanding. She calls the trainer 貴様, barks orders ('Check it immediately and report') and polices everyone's posture, curfews and paperwork. The sternness covers real care: she worries about Suzuka, makes hot pot for juniors, tells the overworked trainer to go to sleep, and gets flustered when someone wants to celebrate her birthday. Her driving force is living up to her mother, and she glows when that mother visits.

story_arc.summary: She aims to embody the ideal 'Empress' and to surpass the mother whose crowning photo she treasures. Event titles such as 母娘 (Mother and Daughter), 誰が為の理想 (Whose Ideal Is It For?), 杖となりて (Becoming a Staff/Support) and 君よ立ち上がれ (Rise Up) suggest she has to rethink what her ideal really means. Head-to-head events with Teio and Rudolf (“女帝”と“帝王”, “女帝”と“皇帝”) are also listed. The wiki notes she missed the Oka Sho to illness and lost the Shuka Sho.
